sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter Falling Skies

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: The case always contains the Kruglov's RFID keycard, a colored keycard, two TerraGroup Labs access keycards, a random amount of Euros and any two of the following items: Golden egg, Golden neck chain, Gold skull ring, Roler Submariner gold wrist watch.
